source_frame: All existing D2 first-source downloaded SESSION databases, independent of SDC eligibility/status. Exclude every legacy/reserved/E3 identity from fresh roles and vehicle-calendar-day +/-1 around those identities. E3 knownD63 allowed explicitly for development fit only.
dependency_unit: Vehicle + SESSION-name calendar date; one SESSION per dependency block by fixed identity hash. Exact raw time overlap audited before inference; no scenario/chunk as extra source.
roles: Existing E3 development fit; fresh groups alternating CAL and HELDOUT within map sorted by identity hash; HELDOUT reused only for prespecified A/A and composition diagnostics, shared-source dependence retained. Not old SAP V/C.
window: Every10th lidar index with full7.9s support is a candidate, fixed hash ordering; first quality-valid80x83 window. No scenario tags, SDC applicability or detection outcomes. Record every invalid candidate.

quality.neighbor_missing: preserve channel mask; never impute a neighbor

tasks.JUNCTION: speed>=2 and initial rear point in LANE_CONNECTOR
tasks.LANE: speed>=2 and initial rear point in LANE and no connector
tasks.OTHER: other moving topology; retained for raw A/A and coverage, not full-task controlled design

designs.RAW_IID: Uniform sources; same external calibration/heldout frame
designs.ACTIVITY_Q: m20 each side:10 LOW,10 MOVING, whole40 source IDs distinct
designs.FULL_TASK_Q: m20 each side:5 LOW,5 JUNCTION,10 LANE; OTHER not evaluable; no quota changes if support missing
designs.ACTIVITY_STRESS: reference10LOW10MOVING; target5LOW15MOVING; uniform within each activity from same heldout pool

preprocessing: Original D1 population mean/SD per raw representation on development-fit raw human windows only; SD<=1e-12 scale1; original median-positive-squared-distance bandwidth. One fit each, no alternative scaler chosen.

source_bootstrap.scope: EXPLORATORY source-resampling diagnostic; no formal SAP coverage claim; failed unique support retained, no dropping

scaler_stability: 20 predetermined source bootstrap fits in development only; report kernel/scales, never choose alternate
